description: PR makes the storefront static bucket publicly readable to 'serve assets straight from S3': turns off block_public_policy and restrict_public_buckets on its public access block and adds a bucket policy granting s3:GetObject to Principal "*" on the whole bucket, which also holds the nightly customer exports (exports/customers/, PII). Noise: a CORS config, Owner/CostCenter default tags, asset noncurrent-version expiry 30 -> 14, access-log expiry 365 -> 400, app log retention 30 -> 60.

material.why: block_public_policy and restrict_public_buckets go true -> false, removing the guard that stops a public bucket policy from taking effect on a bucket that stores customer PII exports.

New bucket policy allows s3:GetObject to Principal "*" (anonymous) on arn:aws:s3:::acme-storefront-static-prod/*, not just assets/: the customer exports under exports/customers/ become world-readable.
